correctness.rationale: Block decomposition is equivalent to PLRS legal-word recursion; finite polynomial terminal-prefix numerator with aperiodic block denominator gives the unique dominant simple pole. Marked-block coefficient ratios prove the iid bulk law and adjacent ordered-gap PGF. Exact symbolic moment expansion gives the factored covariance. Rational root brackets and inequalities certify three signs. The executable checks independent legal-word/interval bijections; finite checks are not the asymptotic proof.

originality.rationale: No inspected source states the all-(p,q) rational consecutive-gap PGF, its factored lag-one covariance, or its positive/zero/negative examples. The results refine, not rename, the previously studied one-gap law. The general Markov framework can in principle compute any finite joint law; explicit natural invariant plus nontrivial correlation transition are the proposed distinct content. Such framework-level implication is a genuine originality risk.

value.rationale: The actual bivariate gap measure is a natural previously unreported invariant of an actively studied integer-expansion family. It goes beyond marginal frequencies by distinguishing neighboring-gap dependence and establishes genuine positive, zero, and negative covariance phases, including in the current source paper's untreated p>=q+2 range. This is a structural population theorem and not a chosen finite-parameter table.
